Vinyl Crackle Adder

Give any track an authentic vinyl feel — procedurally generated crackle, pops and surface hiss mixed into your audio.

Crackle is synthesized procedurally — random decaying pops plus filtered hiss. No samples used. Runs in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose an audio file.
  2. Set crackle intensity, pop density and hiss.
  3. Preview the vinyl-ized result.
  4. Download the WAV.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Is the crackle real or a sample?

Crackle is synthesized from scratch: sparse random impulses with exponential decay (pops) plus filtered noise (surface hiss). No samples are used.

What can I adjust?

The crackle mix, pop density and hiss level are all adjustable so you can go from subtle warmth to battered flea-market record.

Is my audio uploaded?

Yes — generation and mixing happen in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
